description: Generic escape hatch: executes ANY HTTP method against api.ui.com{path}. Use when no dedicated tool exists. Auth, retry, error parsing and pagination hints are handled automatically.

confirm.description: "YES" to apply; without it the tool returns a preview.

dry_run.description: true: preview only, nothing is sent.

path.description: Relative path beginning with "/v1/…" against the configured API base (api.ui.com). Example: "/v1/hosts".

query.description: Query parameters as flat string map

name: unifi_raw_request
title: UniFi raw request
